name: Weekly Report
tagline: A Monday digest of last week: meetings, email, and every action item you committed to, traced to its source.
who: Leaders and investors whose week is back-to-back meetings, and anyone who wants Monday to start with what happened, what they promised, and what needs them, without rereading anything.
how:
Every Monday, or whenever you ask, your agent sweeps the week's meeting notes, email and calendar, and delivers a one-page report doc with four sections:

- Top of mind
- This week's meetings
- A deduped action-item list
- Next week's prep

You also get a two-line summary in chat. If a source is missing, the agent works with what it has and flags the gap once.
changelog: Reads the context doc first; adds the accountability footer.
